----- components/Tombol.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol". Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and theme.css (imports tokens.css).
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';

export type TombolProps = {
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  arah?: "row" | "column";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Tombol({ label = "Tombol", showIcon = true, arah = "row", className, style }: TombolProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${{ row: "relative flex flex-row gap-[6px] items-center p-[8px_16px] bg-[color:var(--colors-brand)] rounded-[8px] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] w-[fit-content]", column: "relative flex flex-col gap-[6px] items-center p-[8px_16px] bg-[color:var(--colors-brand)] rounded-[8px] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] w-[fit-content]" }[arah]}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className="[font-family:Inter] font-[600] not-italic text-[14px] leading-[20px] text-[#FFFFFF] whitespace-pre box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto]">
        {label}
      </div>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className="box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_16px] w-[16px] h-[16px]">
          <svg className="overflow-visible block" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <path d="M5 12h14" />
            <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
          </svg>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Tombol;

----- components/Kartu.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Kartu". Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and theme.css (imports tokens.css).
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Tombol } from './Tombol';

export type KartuProps = {
  title?: string;
  body?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Kartu({ title = "Judul", body, className, style }: KartuProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`relative flex flex-col gap-[8px] p-[16px] bg-[#FFFFFF] rounded-[12px] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] w-[240px] after:content-[''] after:absolute after:inset-[0] after:box-border after:pointer-events-none after:m-[0] after:z-auto after:rounded-[12px] after:[border-top:1px_solid_#E4E7EC] after:[border-right:1px_solid_#E4E7EC] after:[border-bottom:1px_solid_#E4E7EC] after:[border-left:1px_solid_#E4E7EC] ${className ?? ''}`.trimEnd()} style={style}>
      <div className="[font-family:Inter] font-[600] not-italic text-[16px] leading-[24px] text-[color:var(--colors-teks)] whitespace-pre-wrap [overflow-wrap:break-word] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] self-stretch w-[auto]">
        {title}
      </div>
      <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-[4px] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] self-stretch w-[auto]">
        {body ?? (
          <div className="[font-family:Inter] font-[400] not-italic text-[14px] leading-[20px] text-[#344054] whitespace-pre-wrap [overflow-wrap:break-word] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] self-stretch w-[auto]">
            Isi bawaan
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <Tombol label="Buka" />
    </div>
  );
}

export default Kartu;
